records.title: Trio-ViT: Post-Training Quantization and Acceleration for Softmax-Free Efficient Vision Transformer
records.reason: Trio-ViT combines post-training quantization and a dedicated accelerator for softmax-free vision transformers, reporting up to 3.6x–7.3x FPS gains at comparable accuracy. It is a concrete transformer quantization/accelerator result, but experiments are ViT-only and transfer to NLP is unestablished.

records.title: ESPN: Memory-Efficient Multi-vector Information Retrieval
records.reason: ESPN compresses multi-vector neural retrieval indexes to reduce memory/storage while preserving retrieval, including a memory-efficient partial re-ranking design. This is IR index efficiency rather than generation/inference of an LLM; the microexponent lineage connection is weak but plausible for retrieval systems.

records.title: FET-OPU: A Flexible and Efficient FPGA-Based Overlay Processor for Transformer Networks
records.reason: IEEE publisher full text was not available. The abstract describes a flexible FPGA overlay processor for transformer workloads and reports speed/energy improvements, but implementation and evaluated model/task details could not be verified from primary full text.

records.title: Bridging Fairness and Environmental Sustainability in Natural Language Processing
records.reason: The paper studies the relationship between fairness and environmental sustainability in NLP systems. It analyzes trade-offs in social/environmental outcomes rather than proposing an inference-efficiency mechanism.

records.title: Learning to Sample Effective and Diverse Prompts for Text-to-Image Generation
records.reason: The paper learns diverse prompts for text-to-image reward optimization. It changes prompt selection for image quality, not inference compute or memory.
